artifacts.synopsis: The SJC found the complaint judicially out of order (20-2) because BCO 43-1 permits complaints only against acts of a court of the church, not against actions taken in a congregational meeting; the case involved complainants who alleged minor communicant members were wrongly prevented from voting on accepting their associate pastor's resignation, with concurring and dissenting opinions extensively addressing the question of minor communicant suffrage rights and the scope of BCO 43 jurisdiction.

artifacts.title: Relationship of assistant pastor to congregation under BCO 22

matches.evidence: An overture detailing how assistant pastors are called was found in conflict with BCO 3-2 and 12-2 through 12-4, as the relationship of an assistant pastor to a congregation is best left to the session.
